messages:
ops-bot: ALERT - gpu-pool-us-west-2 hotpath queue above threshold (queue=21,300) and tokenbucket drop rate 48% — paging oncall
oncall-ryan: I'm awake. grabbing logs and tracing. tagging ENG-RUNTIME and ENG-SRE.
liz: seeing a lot of 429s in dashboards, p50 jumping from 120ms -> 1.2s. Customers on "enterprise-prem" seeing failures.
sanjay: autoscaler tried to add nodes repeatedly but kube nodes stuck NotReady. kubelet shows failed init due to mount timeout on ephemeral NVMe. looks like node image has incorrect init script.
leo: risk: autoscaler max parallel set to 2; new scale ops queued and blocked by cooldown. when queued, tokenbucket assumed capacity stayed same and started dropping.
engbot: emergency mitigation suggestions:
  - widen tokenbucket ceiling for enterprise-prem for 45m
  - route 15% of enterprise-prem traffic to cpu-fallback region
  - increase autoscaler parallelism to 8 and clear lock
  - manual bootstrap of 4 nodes
oncall-ryan: applying 1) now. patching token config: ```
routes:
  - path: /api/generate
    tiers:
      enterprise-prem: token_rate: 1800
``` 
ops-bot: tokenbucket config updated. watching drop rate.
customer-ops: notified top 10 impacted customers (ACME, BetaCorp, Foundry) with an acknowledgement message. they're asking for ETA.
liz: running divert command to send 15% to cpu-fallback-usw2: `routectl divert /api/generate --pct 15 --target cpu-fallback-usw2`
infra-bot: started manual bootstrap of nodes in group gpu-hotpath-usw2-b. image pull logs show transient registry 503s at 02:41-02:43 UTC.
sanjay: switched bootstrap to internal-mirror and retried. nodes now coming Ready. starting to drain overloaded nodes.
ops-bot: queue backlog falling: 21.3k -> 5.8k over 18m. token drop rate down to 6%.
leo: follow-up: tokenbucket generator uses static headroom factor; under saturation it computes tokens too conservatively. filing INF-1012.
engbot: note: autoscaler lock logic allowed scale ops to queue without visibility; adding alerts for pending-scale-ops > 3min.
customer-ops: ACME confirms service recovered for most requests; they want a post-incident summary.
oncall-ryan: declaring mitigations stable. I'll own RCA and follow-ups: actions - fix init script causing NVMe mount timeouts, harden registry mirror routing, make tokenbucket conservative under queue spike, add emergency console toggle for traffic diversion.
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED - gpu-pool-us-west-2 - mitigations applied; monitoring for 1h. severity lowered to Sev 3.
customer-ops: preparing templated incident note to send to affected accounts. will include timeline and mitigation steps.
sanjay: saved logs to /incidents/2026/2076543210-boot-logs.tar.gz and kube events to /incidents/2026/2076543210-kube-events.log
leo: one last thing: create a runbook entry for "registry-induced bootstrap failures" and test via chaos-engineering.
oncall-ryan: thanks team. handing over to ENG-SRE for RCA. :thumbsup:
